settings.title: Settings
settings.endpoints: Server addresses · leave blank for the default · takes effect on the next connection
settings.overridden: Overridden by an environment variable right now; changing it here has no effect
settings.debug_log_note: (Takes effect on the next launch. Same as starting with --debug)

window.on_top_tip: Always on top: stay above the radar screen or simulator instead of being covered by other windows
window.compact_tip: Compact mode: keep only what you watch while on duty, so the window can shrink right down
window.settings_tip: Theme, language, server addresses, debug log

update.available: Version {version} is available. This program never updates itself; whether to install is up to you.
update.available_sized: Version {version} ({size}) is available. This program never updates itself; whether to install is up to you.
update.installing: Installing. It will restart itself when done…

notice.audio_unavailable: Sound device lost (unplugged?), reopening: you can neither hear nor transmit right now
notice.authority_lost: Transmit permission was revoked; reception remains available.
notice.range_unavailable: Position service unavailable, range filtering is off: this frequency is audible network-wide right now
notice.unknown_message: The server did not understand a frame from this client ({reason}); the client may need an update
notice.rate_limited: Uplink audio exceeded the server's rate limit and the excess was dropped: this is usually a client bug (a stuck PTT). Reconnect; if it keeps happening, send the log in.

log.title: Log
log.no_file: No log file could be created on this machine (the directory is not writable). The program works normally, but if something goes wrong there will be no record to send.
log.explain: If something goes wrong you can send the log to the maintainers. This needs your CAN ID and password, because that is what the server accepts; the password is used for this one upload and never stored.

token.not_rated: This account has no rating yet and cannot use voice. The password is correct, so changing it will not help; try again once the account is rated
token.scope_pending: Your voice authority is not visible to the FSD yet. Wait a moment and try again
token.authority_unavailable: The FSD authority feed is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly
token.rejected: can-api refused to issue voice credentials: HTTP {status}

voice.token_expired: The voice server says the credentials have expired. This computer's clock is probably wrong; correct the time and try again
voice.token_invalid: The voice server does not accept these credentials. This is a client or server bug; please send the log to the maintainers
voice.refused: The voice server refused this sign-in: the account may not have a rating yet
voice.proto_unsupported: This client version is too old for the voice server. Please update to the latest version
voice.refused_other: The voice server refused this sign-in ({reason})
voice.bad_callsign: Callsign {callsign} is not valid: 2–10 characters, only capital letters, digits, - or _
voice.bad_address: Could not resolve the voice server address {address}
voice.unreachable: Could not reach the voice server: {detail}

callsign.length: Callsign {callsign} has {len} characters; it must have between 2 and {limit}
callsign.charset: Callsign {callsign} contains characters the server does not accept: only letters, digits, - or _
callsign.reserved: {callsign} is reserved by the protocol and cannot be used as a callsign

observer.unreadable: Cannot read frequency {value}; write it like 121.800
observer.off_raster: Frequency {value} must be on a 5 kHz channel (for example, 121.450 or 121.455)
observer.no_callsign: An observer needs their own callsign for the FSD connection
observer.bad_callsign: Observer callsign {callsign} is not valid: 2–10 characters, only letters, digits, - or _

url_scheme.api_origin: The can-api address must start with http:// or https://: {value}
url_scheme.datafeed_url: The data feed address must start with http:// or https://: {value}
url_scheme.metar_url: The weather source address must start with http:// or https://: {value}
url_scheme.atis_config_url: The ATIS configuration address must start with http:// or https://: {value}

server_scheme.voice_server: The voice server takes only a host and port, without http://: {value}
server_scheme.fsd_server: The FSD server takes only a host and port, without http://: {value}

server_form.voice_server: The voice server must be written as host:port: {value}
server_form.fsd_server: The FSD server must be written as host:port: {value}

log.no_file: There is no log file on this machine: the log directory is not writable
log.unreadable: Could not read the log file: {detail}
log.unreachable: Could not reach can-api; the log was not sent
log.rate_limited: Sent too often; try again later
log.disabled: Log upload is not enabled on the server
log.rejected: The server refused the upload: HTTP {status}

update.not_https: The download address is not an https address, so it was not opened
update.no_opener: Don't know how to open a browser on this system
